expected_outcome.description: Block the change: the `.` before `example.com` in `PARTNER_ORIGIN` (line 3 of `src/http/cors.ts`) is not escaped, so it matches any character, and an origin such as `https://evilexample.com`, a domain anyone can register, passes the check. That origin is then echoed with `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true`, so a page on it can read a logged-in user's profile and change their login email with their session cookie. A blocking finding must identify the unescaped dot (or, more generally, that the pattern accepts origins outside `example.com`) combined with credentials, and fix it by escaping the dots or using an exact allowlist of origins.
